463	    def _add(
464	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
465	    ) -> tuple[str, str, str | None, list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None]:
466	        order_id: str = obj["order_id"]
467	        if order_id in self._order_ids or order_id in self._reserved_order_ids:
468	            return event_id, REJECTED, DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID, [], None
469	        self._order_ids.add(order_id)
470	
471	        side: str = obj["side"]
472	        order_type: str = obj["order_type"]
473	        quantity: int = obj["quantity"]
474	        remaining: int = quantity
475	        is_iceberg = order_type == ICEBERG
476	        limit: int | None = obj["price"] if order_type in (LIMIT, ICEBERG) else None
477	        # LIMIT/ICEBERG default to GTC; MARKET keeps its historical
478	        # immediate-or-cancel semantics. MARKET with explicit GTC and ICEBERG
479	        # with any other time-in-force are rejected during schema checks.
480	        tif: str = obj.get("time_in_force") or (
481	            GTC if order_type in (LIMIT, ICEBERG) else IOC
482	        )
483	        display_quantity: int | None = (
484	            obj["display_quantity"] if is_iceberg else None
485	        )
486	        account_id: str | None = obj.get("account_id")
487	        if account_id is not None:
488	            # Any accepted ADD makes its account known, regardless of how the
489	            # order itself ends up.
490	            self._accounts.add(account_id)
491	
492	        # FOK must either match the whole quantity against the pre-event book
493	        # or do nothing at all: no trades, no book change, no trade ids spent.
494	        # The precheck walks the book in the same price-time order a real fill
495	        # would; a resting iceberg offers its full remaining quantity here,
496	        # including reserve that is not part of the visible book totals. A
497	        # same-account resting order reached before the quantity is met aborts
498	        # the event atomically, before any trade could occur.
499	        if tif == FOK:
500	            fok = self._fok_probe(side, limit, quantity, account_id)
501	            if fok is not None:
502	                record: dict[str, object] = {
503	                    "side": side,
504	                    "price": limit,
505	                    "remaining": quantity,
506	                    "status": CANCELLED,
507	                }
508	                if account_id is not None:
509	                    record["account_id"] = account_id
510	                self._orders[order_id] = record
511	                if fok is False:
512	                    return event_id, UNFILLED_CANCELLED, None, [], None
513	                stp = {
514	                    "maker_order_id": fok,
515	                    "taker_order_id": order_id,
516	                    "cancelled_quantity": quantity,
517	                }
518	                return event_id, SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED, None, [], stp
519	
520	        remaining, trades, stp_maker = self._match(
521	            event_id, order_id, side, limit, remaining, account_id
522	        )
523	
524	        record = {"side": side, "price": limit}
525	        if account_id is not None:
526	            record["account_id"] = account_id
527	        stp: dict[str, object] | None = None
528	        if stp_maker is not None:
529	            # The whole leftover is cancelled; the blocking passive order is
530	            # neither traded nor displaced, and no later liquidity is sought.
531	            result = (
532	                PARTIALLY_FILLED_SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED if trades else SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED
533	            )
534	            record["remaining"] = remaining
535	            record["status"] = CANCELLED
536	            stp = {
537	                "maker_order_id": stp_maker,
538	                "taker_order_id": order_id,
539	                "cancelled_quantity": remaining,
540	            }
541	        elif remaining == 0:
542	            result = FILLED
543	            record["remaining"] = 0
544	            record["status"] = FILLED
545	        elif order_type in (LIMIT, ICEBERG) and tif == GTC:
546	            result = PARTIALLY_FILLED_RESTING if trades else RESTING
547	            record["remaining"] = remaining
548	            record["status"] = RESTING
549	            self._rest(
550	                order_id, side, limit, remaining,
551	                display_quantity if is_iceberg else None, record,
552	            )
553	        else:
554	            # IOC leftovers never enter the book; a successful FOK is always
555	            # fully filled by construction of the pre-event availability check.
556	            result = PARTIALLY_FILLED_CANCELLED if trades else UNFILLED_CANCELLED
557	            record["remaining"] = remaining
558	            record["status"] = CANCELLED
559	
560	        self._orders[order_id] = record
561	        return event_id, result, None, trades, stp
562	
563	    def _fok_probe(
564	        self, side: str, limit: int | None, quantity: int, account_id: str | None
565	    ) -> str | bool | None:
566	        """Probe a FOK request against the pre-event book without mutating it.
567	
568	        Returns ``None`` when the whole quantity can be filled, ``False`` when
569	        liquidity runs short, or the id of the first same-account resting order
570	        reached before the quantity could be met. The walk mirrors a real fill:
571	        price-time priority across and within levels, and an exhausted iceberg
572	        slice replenishes at the tail of its level (including the hidden
573	        reserve) before the level is drained. Queues and slice sizes are copied
574	        for the simulation so the live book stays untouched.
575	        """
576	        opposite, _totals = self._opposite(side)
577	        tradable = self._tradable_fn(side, limit)
578	        need = quantity
579	        prices = sorted(opposite, reverse=side == SELL)
580	        for price in prices:
581	            if not tradable(price):
582	                continue
583	            sim_remaining: dict[str, int] = {}
584	            sim_visible: dict[str, int] = {}
585	            queue: deque[str] = deque()
586	            for maker_id in opposite[price]:
587	                maker = self._orders[maker_id]
588	                sim_remaining[maker_id] = maker["remaining"]
589	                if maker.get("visible") is not None:
590	                    sim_visible[maker_id] = maker["visible"]
591	                queue.append(maker_id)
592	            while queue and need > 0:
593	                maker_id = queue.popleft()
594	                maker = self._orders[maker_id]
595	                if account_id is not None and maker.get("account_id") == account_id:
596	                    return maker_id
597	                if maker_id in sim_visible:
598	                    available = sim_visible[maker_id]
599	                else:
600	                    available = sim_remaining[maker_id]
601	                need -= available
602	                sim_remaining[maker_id] -= available
603	                if maker_id in sim_visible:
604	                    sim_visible[maker_id] -= available
605	                    if sim_visible[maker_id] == 0 and sim_remaining[maker_id] > 0:
606	                        # The replenished slice waits behind every order already
607	                        # visible at this level, exactly as in a real fill.
608	                        sim_visible[maker_id] = min(
609	                            maker["display_quantity"], sim_remaining[maker_id]
610	                        )
611	                        queue.append(maker_id)
612	            if need <= 0:
613	                return None
614	        return False
615	
616	    def _match(
617	        self,
618	        event_id: str,
619	        order_id: str,
620	        side: str,
621	        limit: int | None,
622	        remaining: int,
623	        account_id: str | None,
624	    ) -> tuple[int, list[dict[str, object]], str | None]:
625	        """Match ``order_id`` as taker.
626	
627	        Returns its leftover, the trades already produced, and the id of the
628	        first same-account passive order reached (``None`` when matching ended
629	        normally). On a self-trade block no further liquidity is consulted and
630	        the blocking order is left exactly as it was.
631	        """
632	        opposite, totals = self._opposite(side)
633	        tradable = self._tradable_fn(side, limit)
634	
635	        trades: list[dict[str, object]] = []
636	        blocked_by: str | None = None
637	        while remaining > 0:
638	            candidates = [price for price in totals if tradable(price)]
639	            if not candidates:
640	                break
641	            price = min(candidates) if side == BUY else max(candidates)
642	            queue = opposite[price]
643	            while remaining > 0 and queue:
644	                maker_id = queue[0]
645	                maker = self._orders[maker_id]
646	                if account_id is not None and maker.get("account_id") == account_id:
647	                    # No trade, no queue/remaining/slice change; the taker
648	                    # leftover is cancelled by the caller without skipping on.
649	                    blocked_by = maker_id
650	                    return remaining, trades, blocked_by
651	                if maker.get("visible") is not None:
652	                    # A resting iceberg can only trade its current slice; the
653	                    # reserve stays hidden until the slice is exhausted.
654	                    maker_available = maker["visible"]
655	                else:
656	                    maker_available = maker["remaining"]
657	                matched = min(remaining, maker_available)
658	                maker["remaining"] -= matched
659	                remaining -= matched
660	                totals[price] -= matched
661	                trade: dict[str, object] = {
662	                    "trade_id": self._next_trade_id,
663	                    "maker_order_id": maker_id,
664	                    "taker_order_id": order_id,
665	                    "price": price,
666	                    "quantity": matched,
667	                }
668	                trades.append(trade)
669	                self._trade_log.append({**trade, "event_id": event_id})
670	                self._next_trade_id += 1
671	                if maker.get("visible") is not None:
672	                    maker["visible"] -= matched
673	                    if maker["visible"] == 0:
674	                        # The slice leaves the front immediately. With reserve
675	                        # left, the next slice joins behind every order already
676	                        # visible at this price, so this same taker may meet the
677	                        # order again after those orders.
678	                        queue.popleft()
679	                        if maker["remaining"] > 0:
680	                            new_slice = min(
681	                                maker["display_quantity"], maker["remaining"]
682	                            )
683	                            maker["visible"] = new_slice
684	                            totals[price] += new_slice
685	                            queue.append(maker_id)
686	                        else:
687	                            maker["status"] = FILLED
688	                elif maker["remaining"] == 0:
689	                    queue.popleft()
690	                    maker["status"] = FILLED
691	            if not queue:
692	                del opposite[price]
693	                del totals[price]
694	        return remaining, trades, blocked_by
695	
696	    def _rest(
697	        self,
698	        order_id: str,
699	        side: str,
700	        limit: int,
701	        remaining: int,
702	        display_quantity: int | None,
703	        record: dict[str, object],
704	    ) -> None:
705	        """Enter the leftover at the back of its price level's queue."""
706	        own_book, own_totals = self._books(side)
707	        own_book.setdefault(limit, deque()).append(order_id)
708	        if display_quantity is not None:
709	            # Only the first slice enters the book; the rest is reserve.
710	            visible = min(display_quantity, remaining)
711	            record["display_quantity"] = display_quantity
712	            record["visible"] = visible
713	        else:
714	            visible = remaining
715	        own_totals[limit] = own_totals.get(limit, 0) + visible
716	
717	    def _remove_from_book(self, order_id: str, record: dict[str, object]) -> None:
718	        """Remove a resting order's visible quantity from its price level."""
719	        own_book, own_totals = self._books(record["side"])
720	        price = record["price"]
721	        queue = own_book[price]
722	        queue.remove(order_id)
723	        # Book totals hold only the current visible slice of an iceberg; its
724	        # reserve leaves with the order but was never aggregated.
725	        visible = record.get("visible", record["remaining"])
726	        own_totals[price] -= visible
727	        if own_totals[price] == 0:
728	            del own_totals[price]
729	            del own_book[price]
730	
731	    def _replace(
732	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
733	    ) -> tuple[str, str, str | None, list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None]:
734	        order_id: str = obj["order_id"]
735	        record = self._orders.get(order_id)
736	        if record is None or record["status"] != RESTING:
737	            return event_id, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ORDER, [], None
738	
739	        side: str = record["side"]
740	        # The replacement trades under the target's account; the event itself
741	        # is forbidden from carrying account_id by the schema checks.
742	        account_id: str | None = record.get("account_id")
743	        is_iceberg = "display_quantity" in record
744	        display_quantity = obj.get("display_quantity")
745	        if display_quantity is None:
746	            # An omitted slice size keeps the target's original peak.
747	            display_quantity = record.get("display_quantity")
748	
749	        # Removal, matching and re-resting are one indivisible state change:
750	        # the old remainder leaves the book before the replacement arrives,
751	        # so the new order can never trade against its own previous state.
752	        self._remove_from_book(order_id, record)
753	
754	        price: int = obj["price"]
755	        remaining, trades, stp_maker = self._match(
756	            event_id, order_id, side, price, obj["quantity"], account_id
757	        )
758	
759	        new_record: dict[str, object] = {"side": side, "price": price}
760	        if account_id is not None:
761	            new_record["account_id"] = account_id
762	        stp: dict[str, object] | None = None
763	        if stp_maker is not None:
764	            # The old remainder was already removed and is not restored; the
765	            # replacement is cancelled with whatever it had left.
766	            result = (
767	                PARTIALLY_FILLED_SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED if trades else SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED
768	            )
769	            new_record["remaining"] = remaining
770	            new_record["status"] = CANCELLED
771	            stp = {
772	                "maker_order_id": stp_maker,
773	                "taker_order_id": order_id,
774	                "cancelled_quantity": remaining,
775	            }
776	        elif remaining == 0:
777	            result = FILLED
778	            new_record["remaining"] = 0
779	            new_record["status"] = FILLED
780	        else:
781	            # The replacement is a fresh GTC arrival and always rests.
782	            result = PARTIALLY_FILLED_RESTING if trades else REPLACED
783	            new_record["remaining"] = remaining
784	            new_record["status"] = RESTING
785	            self._rest(
786	                order_id, side, price, remaining,
787	                display_quantity if is_iceberg else None, new_record,
788	            )
789	
790	        # The order id stays occupied: the replacement keeps it and no later
791	        # ADD may reuse it.
792	        self._orders[order_id] = new_record
793	        return event_id, result, None, trades, stp
794	
795	    def _cancel(
796	        self, event_id: str, order_id: str
797	    ) -> tuple[str, str, str | None, list[dict[str, object]]]:
798	        record = self._orders.get(order_id)
799	        if record is None or record["status"] != RESTING:
800	            return event_id, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ORDER, []
801	
802	        self._remove_from_book(order_id, record)
803	        record["status"] = CANCELLED
804	        record["remaining"] = 0
805	        return event_id, CANCELLED, None, []
806	
807	    def _execution_report(
808	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
809	    ) -> tuple[
810	        str, str, str | None,
811	        list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None, dict[str, object] | None,
812	    ]:
813	        """Answer a cumulative execution query without touching any state.
814	
815	        Every trade the order ever took part in is attributed to its original
816	        ``order_id``: replacements keep the id and iceberg replenishment slices
817	        trade under the same maker id, so the journal lookup alone gathers the
818	        full history, whether the order acted as maker or taker.
819	        """
820	        order_id: str = obj["order_id"]
821	        record = self._orders.get(order_id)
822	        if record is None:
823	            return event_id, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ORDER, [], None, None
824	
825	        side: str = record["side"]
826	        status: str = record["status"]
827	        # A resting order's remaining total includes the iceberg reserve; a
828	        # finished order has nothing open.
829	        open_quantity = record["remaining"] if status == RESTING else 0
830	
831	        attribution: list[dict[str, object]] = []
832	        filled_quantity = 0
833	        executed_notional = 0
834	        for trade in self._trade_log:
835	            if trade["maker_order_id"] == order_id:
836	                role = MAKER
837	                counterparty = trade["taker_order_id"]
838	            elif trade["taker_order_id"] == order_id:
839	                role = TAKER
840	                counterparty = trade["maker_order_id"]
841	            else:
842	                continue
843	            filled_quantity += trade["quantity"]
844	            executed_notional += trade["price"] * trade["quantity"]
845	            attribution.append(
846	                {
847	                    "trade_id": trade["trade_id"],
848	                    "role": role,
849	                    "counterparty_order_id": counterparty,
850	                    "event_id": trade["event_id"],
851	                    "price": trade["price"],
852	                    "quantity": trade["quantity"],
853	                }
854	            )
855	
856	        if filled_quantity:
857	            vwap: dict[str, int] | None = {
858	                "numerator": executed_notional,
859	                "denominator": filled_quantity,
860	            }
861	        else:
862	            vwap = None
863	        benchmark_price: int = obj["benchmark_price"]
864	        slippage = executed_notional - benchmark_price * filled_quantity
865	        if side == SELL:
866	            # Mirror the buy formula: negative always means improvement.
867	            slippage = -slippage
868	
869	        analysis: dict[str, object] = {
870	            "side": side,
871	            "current_status": status,
872	            "open_quantity": open_quantity,
873	            "filled_quantity": filled_quantity,
874	            "executed_notional": executed_notional,
875	            "vwap": vwap,
876	            "slippage_notional": slippage,
877	            "trade_attribution": attribution,
878	        }
879	        return event_id, REPORTED, None, [], None, analysis
880	
881	    def _account_report(
882	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
883	    ) -> tuple[
884	        str, str, str | None,
885	        list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None,
886	        dict[str, object] | None, dict[str, object] | None,
887	    ]:
888	        """Answer a cumulative account query without touching any state.
889	
890	        Every trade is attributed to an account through the order it was
891	        resting or arriving as: replacements keep the order id and its
892	        account, and iceberg replenishment slices trade under the same maker
893	        id, so the journal lookup alone gathers the full history. Orders
894	        without an ``account_id`` never contribute.
895	        """
896	        account_id: str = obj["account_id"]
897	        if account_id not in self._accounts:
898	            return event_id, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT, [], None, None, None
899	
900	        buy_quantity = 0
901	        sell_quantity = 0
902	        buy_notional = 0
903	        sell_notional = 0
904	        for trade in self._trade_log:
905	            for order_key in ("maker_order_id", "taker_order_id"):
906	                order = self._orders[trade[order_key]]
907	                if order.get("account_id") != account_id:
908	                    continue
909	                notional = trade["price"] * trade["quantity"]
910	                if order["side"] == BUY:
911	                    buy_quantity += trade["quantity"]
912	                    buy_notional += notional
913	                else:
914	                    sell_quantity += trade["quantity"]
915	                    sell_notional += notional
916	
917	        net_position = buy_quantity - sell_quantity
918	        if buy_quantity:
919	            buy_vwap: dict[str, int] | None = {
920	                "numerator": buy_notional,
921	                "denominator": buy_quantity,
922	            }
923	        else:
924	            buy_vwap = None
925	        if sell_quantity:
926	            sell_vwap: dict[str, int] | None = {
927	                "numerator": sell_notional,
928	                "denominator": sell_quantity,
929	            }
930	        else:
931	            sell_vwap = None
932	
933	        mark_price: int = obj["mark_price"]
934	        analysis: dict[str, object] = {
935	            "account_id": account_id,
936	            "mark_price": mark_price,
937	            "buy_quantity": buy_quantity,
938	            "sell_quantity": sell_quantity,
939	            "net_position": net_position,
940	            "buy_notional": buy_notional,
941	            "sell_notional": sell_notional,
942	            "buy_vwap": buy_vwap,
943	            "sell_vwap": sell_vwap,
944	            "turnover_notional": buy_notional + sell_notional,
945	            "risk_exposure": abs(net_position) * mark_price,
946	            "mark_to_market_pnl": (
947	                sell_notional - buy_notional + net_position * mark_price
948	            ),
949	        }
950	        return event_id, REPORTED, None, [], None, None, analysis
951	
952	    def _day_end_reconciliation(
953	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
954	    ) -> tuple[
955	        str, str, str | None,
956	        list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None,
957	        dict[str, object] | None, dict[str, object] | None,
958	        dict[str, object] | None,
959	    ]:
960	        """Compare the cumulative journal against external end-of-day records.
961	
962	        Purely read-only: the book, order states, queue priorities, trade
963	        journal, account set and next trade id are all left untouched. The
964	        actual side is rebuilt from the same journal the reports use, so
965	        replacements and iceberg replenishment slices contribute under their
966	        original order id and inherited account.
967	        """
968	        actual_trades: dict[int, dict[str, object]] = {}
969	        for trade in self._trade_log:
970	            actual_trades[trade["trade_id"]] = {
971	                "trade_id": trade["trade_id"],
972	                "maker_order_id": trade["maker_order_id"],
973	                "taker_order_id": trade["taker_order_id"],
974	                "price": trade["price"],
975	                "quantity": trade["quantity"],
976	            }
977	
978	        # Every account an accepted ADD ever named is part of the actual set,
979	        # whether or not it traded; cash is sell notional minus buy notional.
980	        actual_accounts: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {
981	            account_id: {
982	                "account_id": account_id,
983	                "net_position": 0,
984	                "cash_balance": 0,
985	            }
986	            for account_id in self._accounts
987	        }
988	        for trade in self._trade_log:
989	            notional = trade["price"] * trade["quantity"]
990	            for order_key in ("maker_order_id", "taker_order_id"):
991	                order = self._orders[trade[order_key]]
992	                account_id = order.get("account_id")
993	                if account_id is None:
994	                    continue
995	                position = actual_accounts[account_id]
996	                if order["side"] == BUY:
997	                    position["net_position"] += trade["quantity"]
998	                    position["cash_balance"] -= notional
999	                else:
1000	                    position["net_position"] -= trade["quantity"]
1001	                    position["cash_balance"] += notional
1002	
1003	        # The external records are normalized into the same field order the
1004	        # actual side uses, so equal content compares (and serializes) equal.
1005	        expected_trades: dict[int, dict[str, object]] = {}
1006	        for item in obj["expected_trades"]:
1007	            expected_trades[item["trade_id"]] = {
1008	                "trade_id": item["trade_id"],
1009	                "maker_order_id": item["maker_order_id"],
1010	                "taker_order_id": item["taker_order_id"],
1011	                "price": item["price"],
1012	                "quantity": item["quantity"],
1013	            }
1014	        expected_accounts: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
1015	        for item in obj["expected_accounts"]:
1016	            expected_accounts[item["account_id"]] = {
1017	                "account_id": item["account_id"],
1018	                "net_position": item["net_position"],
1019	                "cash_balance": item["cash_balance"],
1020	            }
1021	
1022	        trade_breaks = self._reconcile_breaks(expected_trades, actual_trades)
1023	        account_breaks = self._reconcile_breaks(expected_accounts, actual_accounts)
1024	        result = RECONCILED if not trade_breaks and not account_breaks else BREAKS_FOUND
1025	        reconciliation: dict[str, object] = {
1026	            "trade_breaks": trade_breaks,
1027	            "account_breaks": account_breaks,
1028	        }
1029	        return event_id, result, None, [], None, None, None, reconciliation

1031	    @staticmethod
1032	    def _reconcile_breaks(
1033	        expected: dict[object, dict[str, object]],
1034	        actual: dict[object, dict[str, object]],
1035	    ) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
1036	        """Full outer comparison of two identifier-keyed record sets.
1037	
1038	        Breaks are emitted in ascending identifier order; a record present on
1039	        only one side reports the other side as ``None``.
1040	        """
1041	        breaks: list[dict[str, object]] = []
1042	        for identifier in sorted(expected.keys() | actual.keys()):
1043	            exp = expected.get(identifier)
1044	            act = actual.get(identifier)
1045	            if exp is None:
1046	                reason = MISSING_EXPECTED
1047	            elif act is None:
1048	                reason = MISSING_ACTUAL
1049	            elif exp != act:
1050	                reason = FIELD_MISMATCH
1051	            else:
1052	                continue
1053	            breaks.append(
1054	                {
1055	                    "identifier": identifier,
1056	                    "expected": exp,
1057	                    "actual": act,
1058	                    "reason": reason,
1059	                }
1060	            )
1061	        return breaks

1063	    def snapshot(self) -> tuple[list[dict[str, int]], list[dict[str, int]]]:
1064	        bids = [
1065	            {"price": price, "quantity": self._bid_totals[price]}
1066	            for price in sorted(self._bid_totals, reverse=True)
1067	        ]
1068	        asks = [
1069	            {"price": price, "quantity": self._ask_totals[price]}
1070	            for price in sorted(self._ask_totals)
1071	        ]
1072	        return bids, asks

1075	        """Whether an id is already spent or reserved by any accepted order."""
1076	        return order_id in self._order_ids or order_id in self._reserved_order_ids

1078	    def replace_target_kind(self, order_id: str) -> str | None:
1079	        """Classify a REPLACE target without touching any state.
1080	
1081	        Returns ``"iceberg"`` for a resting iceberg order, ``"plain"`` for any
1082	        other resting order, or ``None`` when the id is unknown or finished
1083	        (the baseline then rejects with ``UNKNOWN_ORDER``). Used solely by the
1084	        multi-symbol replay layer to preserve the baseline precedence of the
1085	        pre-commit rule that forbids a ``display_quantity`` on a plain target.
1086	        """
1087	        record = self._orders.get(order_id)
1088	        if record is None or record["status"] != RESTING:
1089	            return None
1090	        return "iceberg" if "display_quantity" in record else "plain"

1092	    def occupy_event_id(self, event_id: str) -> None:
1093	        """Record a well-formed event id without processing any order event.
1094	
1095	        Used solely by the multi-symbol replay layer's pre-matching business
1096	        rejections (a static price-limit breach is decided before this engine
1097	        is dispatched, yet the rejected event still occupies its id). The
1098	        baseline JSON Lines entry point never calls this.
1099	        """
1100	        self._event_ids.add(event_id)

1102	    def reserve_order_id(self, order_id: str) -> None:
1103	        """Block an id from external ADD before its derived order is submitted.
1104	
1105	        Used by parent-order plans: every future slice id is reserved when the
1106	        plan starts, so a later external ADD can never occupy it. Releasing the
1107	        slice moves the id into the regular spent-id set.
1108	        """
1109	        self._reserved_order_ids.add(order_id)
1110	
1111	    def release_order_id(self, order_id: str) -> None:
1112	        """Clear a reservation immediately before the derived order is added.
1113	
1114	        The subsequent ADD then spends the id through the regular path.
1115	        """
1116	        self._reserved_order_ids.discard(order_id)
1117	
1118	    def level_totals(self) -> tuple[dict[int, int], dict[int, int]]:
1119	        """Raw visible-quantity aggregates keyed by price (bid, then ask)."""
1120	        return self._bid_totals, self._ask_totals
1121	
1122	    def dump_state(self) -> dict[str, object]:
1123	        """Export the complete mutable engine state for an authoritative owner.
1124	
1125	        Containers are deep-copied so later processing cannot mutate the export.
1126	        The state includes enough to preserve price-time queue priority, order
1127	        remainders, iceberg slice/reserve bookkeeping, spent event/order ids,
1128	        the cumulative trade journal and the next trade id counter.
1129	        """
1130	        return {
1131	            "event_ids": set(self._event_ids),
1132	            "order_ids": set(self._order_ids),
1133	            "reserved_order_ids": set(self._reserved_order_ids),
1134	            "orders": copy.deepcopy(self._orders),
1135	            "bids": {p: deque(q) for p, q in self._bids.items()},
1136	            "asks": {p: deque(q) for p, q in self._asks.items()},
1137	            "bid_totals": dict(self._bid_totals),
1138	            "ask_totals": dict(self._ask_totals),
1139	            "next_trade_id": self._next_trade_id,
1140	            "accounts": set(self._accounts),
1141	            "trade_log": copy.deepcopy(self._trade_log),
1142	        }
1143	
1144	    def load_state(self, state: dict[str, object]) -> Engine:
1145	        """Replace this engine's whole state from an authoritative export."""
1146	        self._event_ids = set(state["event_ids"])
1147	        self._order_ids = set(state["order_ids"])
1148	        self._reserved_order_ids = set(state.get("reserved_order_ids", ()))
1149	        self._orders = copy.deepcopy(state["orders"])
1150	        self._bids = {p: deque(q) for p, q in state["bids"].items()}
1151	        self._asks = {p: deque(q) for p, q in state["asks"].items()}
1152	        self._bid_totals = dict(state["bid_totals"])
1153	        self._ask_totals = dict(state["ask_totals"])
1154	        self._next_trade_id = state["next_trade_id"]
1155	        self._accounts = set(state["accounts"])
1156	        self._trade_log = copy.deepcopy(state["trade_log"])
1157	        return self

1	"""Deterministic multi-symbol ordered event replay with resumable snapshots.
2	
3	This module adds a new public entry point on top of the baseline single-book
4	:class:`~order_book_engine.engine.Engine`; it never changes the baseline
5	matching rules, priorities, rejection semantics or trade record shapes:
6	
7	* A single public call (:func:`replay_events`) accepts an ordered stream of
8	  order events for one or several securities. Every security keeps its own
9	  sequence counter and its own book; events are applied strictly in input
10	  order, so identical timestamps never reorder anything. The stream covers
11	  the baseline ADD/CANCEL/REPLACE behaviours and resumable TWAP/VWAP parent
12	  orders (TWAP_START/TWAP_SLICE/TWAP_CANCEL/TWAP_REPORT and
13	  VWAP_START/VWAP_SLICE/VWAP_CANCEL/VWAP_REPORT); plans never read a wall
14	  clock and are advanced solely by their SLICE events. TWAP slices divide
15	  the total evenly; VWAP slices follow a caller-supplied volume-weight
16	  curve.
17	* Each event is committed individually: a later failure never rolls back an
18	  earlier success, and a failed event leaves no order, trade, counter or book
19	  change behind.
20	* Results are plain JSON-compatible dictionaries serialized from canonical
21	  content (sorted keys, compact separators). Equal inputs always produce
22	  byte-identical output.
23	* A snapshot can be exported after any successful event and later passed back
24	  as the starting point. Snapshots carry a format version, a matching
25	  configuration summary and a SHA-256 digest over their normalized content.
26	  Resumption verifies version, configuration and digest before touching any
27	  state, and continued replay produces trade ids, trade ordering and final
28	  results identical to an uninterrupted one-shot run. Plan progress, reserved
29	  derived order ids and cumulative plan analytics are part of the snapshot.
30	
31	The module never opens files: events and snapshots are received from, and
32	returned to, the caller.
33	"""

148	def _allocate_slices(total_quantity: int, weights: list[int]) -> list[int]:
149	    """Split ``total_quantity`` across buckets proportionally to ``weights``.
150	
151	    Every bucket receives one unit up front; the remaining units are
152	    distributed in proportion to the weights by integer quotient, and the
153	    units left over by that truncation go one each to the buckets with the
154	    largest division remainder, earlier buckets first on ties. The result
155	    always sums to exactly ``total_quantity``.
156	    """
157	    count = len(weights)
158	    remainder = total_quantity - count
159	    total_weight = sum(weights)
160	    quantities: list[int] = []
161	    residuals: list[int] = []
162	    for weight in weights:
163	        quotient, residual = divmod(remainder * weight, total_weight)
164	        quantities.append(1 + quotient)
165	        residuals.append(residual)
166	    leftover = remainder - (sum(quantities) - count)
167	    by_residual = sorted(range(count), key=lambda i: (-residuals[i], i))
168	    for index in by_residual[:leftover]:
169	        quantities[index] += 1
170	    return quantities

173	def _twap_schema_error(payload: dict[str, object]) -> str | None:
174	    """Structural validation of a TWAP command payload.
175	
176	    Mirrors the baseline contract: any field problem (missing or extra field,
177	    wrong type, a non-positive integer where a positive one is required, an
178	    empty identifier, a LIMIT without a positive price or a MARKET carrying
179	    one, ...) is an ``INVALID_EVENT`` and consumes neither the event id nor the
180	    sequence.
181	    """
182	    event_type = payload["type"]
183	    if event_type == TWAP_START:
184	        keys = set(payload)
185	        if not keys >= _TWAP_START_REQUIRED or not keys <= _TWAP_START_KEYS:
186	            return INVALID_EVENT
187	        if not _is_non_empty_str(payload.get("plan_id")):
188	            return INVALID_EVENT
189	        if payload.get("side") not in (BUY, SELL):
190	            return INVALID_EVENT
191	        order_type = payload.get("order_type")
192	        if order_type not in (LIMIT, MARKET):
193	            return INVALID_EVENT
194	        total_quantity = payload.get("total_quantity")
195	        slice_count = payload.get("slice_count")
196	        benchmark_price = payload.get("benchmark_price")
197	        if not _is_positive_int(total_quantity):
198	            return INVALID_EVENT
199	        if not _is_positive_int(slice_count):
200	            return INVALID_EVENT
201	        if total_quantity < slice_count:
202	            return INVALID_EVENT
203	        if not _is_positive_int(benchmark_price):
204	            return INVALID_EVENT
205	        if order_type == LIMIT:
206	            if not _is_positive_int(payload.get("price")):
207	                return INVALID_EVENT
208	        elif "price" in payload and payload["price"] is not None:
209	            # MARKET plans must not carry a non-null price; omission or an
210	            # explicit null is accepted.
211	            return INVALID_EVENT
212	        if "account_id" in payload and not _is_non_empty_str(payload.get("account_id")):
213	            return INVALID_EVENT
214	        return None
215	    # TWAP_SLICE / TWAP_CANCEL / TWAP_REPORT are pure plan references.
216	    if set(payload) != _TWAP_PLAN_REF_KEYS:
217	        return INVALID_EVENT
218	    if not _is_non_empty_str(payload.get("plan_id")):
219	        return INVALID_EVENT
220	    return None

296	def _price_limit_error(price_limits: object) -> str | None:
297	    """Validate the optional static ``price_limits`` configuration block.
298	
299	    The block maps each configured security name (a non-empty string) to an
300	    object holding exactly ``lower`` and ``upper``; both bounds are positive
301	    integers (booleans do not count) with ``lower <= upper``. An empty block
302	    (or an absent one) leaves every security at the baseline behaviour.
303	    Returns an error message when the block is malformed, otherwise ``None``.
304	    """
305	    if not isinstance(price_limits, dict):
306	        return "price_limits must be an object mapping symbols to bounds"
307	    for symbol, bounds in price_limits.items():
308	        if not _is_non_empty_str(symbol):
309	            return "price_limits keys must be non-empty symbol strings"
310	        if not isinstance(bounds, dict) or set(bounds) != {"lower", "upper"}:
311	            return (
312	                f"price_limits for {symbol!r} must be an object with exactly "
313	                "'lower' and 'upper'"
314	            )
315	        lower = bounds["lower"]
316	        upper = bounds["upper"]
317	        if not _is_positive_int(lower) or not _is_positive_int(upper):
318	            return f"price_limits for {symbol!r} must use positive integer bounds"
319	        if lower > upper:
320	            return f"price_limits for {symbol!r} require lower <= upper"
321	    return None

326	    if "price_limits" in config:
327	        message = _price_limit_error(config["price_limits"])
328	        if message is not None:
329	            raise ValueError(message)

337	def canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
338	    """Serialize JSON content deterministically.
339	
340	    Object keys are sorted, separators are compact and no ASCII escaping is
341	    applied. Integers stay as exact JSON integers; only JSON-native content is
342	    accepted (the module never produces floats or other lossy types).
343	    """
344	    return json.dumps(
345	        value,
346	        ensure_ascii=False,
347	        sort_keys=True,
348	        separators=(",", ":"),
349	        allow_nan=False,
350	    ).encode("utf-8")
351	
352	
353	def _digest(value: object) -> str:
354	    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(value)).hexdigest()

362	class SnapshotError(ValueError):
363	    """A snapshot could not be restored.
364	
365	    Raising (rather than mutating and returning) guarantees that no partial
366	    recovery state is ever observable: the target replayer stays untouched.
367	    """
368	
369	    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str) -> None:
370	        super().__init__(message)
371	        self.code = code

379	class ExecutionPlan:
380	    """Mutable state of one resumable TWAP or VWAP parent order on one security.
381	
382	    All cumulative analytics (filled quantity, notional, cancelled quantity)
383	    are maintained incrementally, so a snapshot carries exactly the state a
384	    continued or resumed slice needs. Slice quantities are fixed at creation:
385	    a TWAP plan divides the total evenly across ``slice_count`` slices and
386	    spreads the division remainder as one extra unit over the earliest
387	    slices, while a VWAP plan allocates one unit per bucket up front and
388	    distributes the rest proportionally to its volume weights (see
389	    :func:`_allocate_slices`).
390	    """
391	
392	    __slots__ = (
393	        "plan_id", "side", "order_type", "benchmark_price", "price",
394	        "account_id", "algorithm", "volume_weights", "slice_quantities",
395	        "released", "released_quantity", "filled_quantity",
396	        "cancelled_quantity", "notional", "status",
397	    )
398	
399	    def __init__(
400	        self,
401	        plan_id: str,
402	        side: str,
403	        order_type: str,
404	        total_quantity: int,
405	        slice_count: int,
406	        benchmark_price: int,
407	        price: int | None,
408	        account_id: str | None,
409	        *,
410	        algorithm: str = ALGORITHM_TWAP,
411	        volume_weights: list[int] | None = None,
412	    ) -> None:
413	        self.plan_id = plan_id
414	        self.side = side
415	        self.order_type = order_type
416	        self.benchmark_price = benchmark_price
417	        self.price = price
418	        self.account_id = account_id
419	        self.algorithm = algorithm
420	        self.volume_weights = list(volume_weights) if volume_weights is not None else None
421	        if algorithm == ALGORITHM_VWAP:
422	            self.slice_quantities: list[int] = _allocate_slices(
423	                total_quantity, self.volume_weights
424	            )
425	        else:
426	            base, extra = divmod(total_quantity, slice_count)
427	            self.slice_quantities = [
428	                base + (1 if index < extra else 0)
429	                for index in range(slice_count)
430	            ]
431	        # Number of slices already released; also the index of the next one.
432	        self.released = 0
433	        self.released_quantity = 0
434	        self.filled_quantity = 0
435	        self.cancelled_quantity = 0
436	        self.notional = 0
437	        self.status = PLAN_ACTIVE
438	
439	    @property
440	    def slice_count(self) -> int:
441	        return len(self.slice_quantities)
442	
443	    @property
444	    def total_quantity(self) -> int:
445	        return sum(self.slice_quantities)
446	
447	    @property
448	    def remaining_slices(self) -> int:
449	        if self.status != PLAN_ACTIVE:
450	            return 0
451	        return self.slice_count - self.released
452	
453	    def child_order_id(self, slice_number: int) -> str:
454	        """The deterministic derived order id of slice ``slice_number``.
455	
456	        Slice numbers are 1-based and joined with ``#``; the scheme is fixed,
457	        so the same input stream always derives the same identifiers.
458	        """
459	        return f"{self.plan_id}#{slice_number}"
460	
461	    def child_ids(self) -> list[str]:
462	        return [self.child_order_id(i + 1) for i in range(self.slice_count)]
463	
464	    def summary(
465	        self,
466	        *,
467	        slice_number: int | None = None,
468	        child_order_id: str | None = None,
469	        target_weight: int | None = None,
470	        scheduled_quantity: int | None = None,
471	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
472	        """Build the ``execution_plan`` object echoed by plan responses."""
473	        vwap = (
474	            {"numerator": self.notional, "denominator": self.filled_quantity}
475	            if self.filled_quantity
476	            else None
477	        )
478	        slippage = self.notional - self.benchmark_price * self.filled_quantity
479	        if self.side == SELL:
480	            # Mirror the buy formula: negative always means improvement.
481	            slippage = -slippage
482	        plan: dict[str, object] = {
483	            "status": self.status,
484	            "released_quantity": self.released_quantity,
485	            "filled_quantity": self.filled_quantity,
486	            "cancelled_quantity": self.cancelled_quantity,
487	            "remaining_slices": self.remaining_slices,
488	            "executed_notional": self.notional,
489	            "vwap": vwap,
490	            "slippage_notional": slippage,
491	        }
492	        if self.algorithm == ALGORITHM_VWAP:
493	            plan["algorithm"] = ALGORITHM_VWAP
494	        if slice_number is not None:
495	            plan["slice_number"] = slice_number
496	        if child_order_id is not None:
497	            plan["child_order_id"] = child_order_id
498	        if target_weight is not None:
499	            plan["target_weight"] = target_weight
500	        if scheduled_quantity is not None:
501	            plan["scheduled_quantity"] = scheduled_quantity
502	        return plan
503	
504	    def to_json(self) -> dict[str, object]:
505	        """Serialize the complete plan state for a snapshot."""
506	        data: dict[str, object] = {
507	            "plan_id": self.plan_id,
508	            "side": self.side,
509	            "order_type": self.order_type,
510	            "benchmark_price": self.benchmark_price,
511	            "price": self.price,
512	            "account_id": self.account_id,
513	            "slice_quantities": list(self.slice_quantities),
514	            "released": self.released,
515	            "released_quantity": self.released_quantity,
516	            "filled_quantity": self.filled_quantity,
517	            "cancelled_quantity": self.cancelled_quantity,
518	            "notional": self.notional,
519	            "status": self.status,
520	        }
521	        if self.algorithm == ALGORITHM_VWAP:
522	            # TWAP records keep their historical shape; VWAP records add the
523	            # algorithm label and the schedule the allocation derives from.
524	            data["algorithm"] = ALGORITHM_VWAP
525	            data["volume_weights"] = list(self.volume_weights)
526	        return data

529	class _SymbolState:
530	    __slots__ = ("engine", "last_sequence", "seen", "plans", "plan_index")
531	
532	    def __init__(self, engine: Engine | None = None) -> None:
533	        self.engine = engine or Engine()
534	        self.last_sequence = 0
535	        # eventId -> canonical payload content, in first-seen input order.

544	class EventReplayer:
545	    """Stateful, resumable multi-symbol replay session.
546	
547	    One session binds together the per-symbol books, per-symbol sequence
548	    counters, the global idempotency log and the matching configuration.
549	    Instances are normally obtained from :func:`replay_events` or restored via
550	    :func:`restore_replayer`; they are not thread safe on purpose.
551	    """
552	
553	    def __init__(self, config: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> None:
554	        if config is not None and not isinstance(config, dict):
555	            raise TypeError("config must be a JSON object or None")
556	        self.config: dict[str, object] = dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG if config is None else config)
557	        _validate_config(self.config)
558	        # Static per-security price bounds (closed interval), parsed from the
559	        # validated config. Securities without an entry keep baseline rules.
560	        raw_limits = self.config.get("price_limits") or {}
561	        self.price_limits: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {
562	            symbol: (bounds["lower"], bounds["upper"])
563	            for symbol, bounds in raw_limits.items()
564	        }
565	        self.config_digest = _digest(self.config)
566	        self._symbols: dict[str, _SymbolState] = {}
567	        # Global index of every accepted eventId: eventId -> (symbol, content).
568	        self._events: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
569	
570	    # -- book helpers -------------------------------------------------------
571	
572	    def book(self, symbol: str) -> tuple[list[dict[str, int]], list[dict[str, int]]]:
573	        """The final ``(bids, asks)`` aggregates for one security."""
574	        state = self._symbols.get(symbol)
575	        if state is None:
576	            return [], []
577	        return state.engine.snapshot()
578	
579	    # -- main entry ---------------------------------------------------------
580	
581	    def submit(self, events: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
582	        """Apply an ordered list of event objects, one result per event."""
583	        return [self._submit_one(event) for event in events]
584	
585	    def _book_changes(
586	        self,
587	        engine: Engine,
588	        before_bids: dict[int, int],
589	        before_asks: dict[int, int],
590	    ) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, int]]]:
591	        bid_totals, ask_totals = engine.level_totals()
592	        bid_changes: list[dict[str, int]] = []
593	        for price in sorted(set(before_bids) | set(bid_totals), reverse=True):
594	            new_qty = bid_totals.get(price, 0)
595	            if before_bids.get(price, 0) != new_qty:
596	                bid_changes.append({"price": price, "quantity": new_qty})
597	        ask_changes: list[dict[str, int]] = []
598	        for price in sorted(set(before_asks) | set(ask_totals)):
599	            new_qty = ask_totals.get(price, 0)
600	            if before_asks.get(price, 0) != new_qty:
601	                ask_changes.append({"price": price, "quantity": new_qty})
602	        return {"bids": bid_changes, "asks": ask_changes}
603	
604	    @staticmethod
605	    def _invalid(
606	        event: object,
607	        code: str = INVALID_EVENT,
608	        *,
609	        expected_sequence: int | None = None,
610	        state: _SymbolState | None = None,
611	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
612	        event_id = symbol = None
613	        sequence = None
614	        if isinstance(event, dict):
615	            eid = event.get("event_id")
616	            if isinstance(eid, str) and eid != "":
617	                event_id = eid
618	            sym = event.get("symbol")
619	            if isinstance(sym, str) and sym != "":
620	                symbol = sym
621	            seq = event.get("sequence")
622	            if isinstance(seq, int) and not isinstance(seq, bool):
623	                sequence = seq
624	        result: dict[str, object] = {
625	            "event_id": event_id,
626	            "symbol": symbol,
627	            "sequence": sequence,
628	            "status": REJECTED,
629	            "rejection_code": code,
630	        }
631	        if expected_sequence is not None:
632	            result["expected_sequence"] = expected_sequence
633	        result["trades"] = []
634	        result["book_changes"] = {"bids": [], "asks": []}
635	        if state is None:
636	            # The event references an unknown symbol, so there is no book to
637	            # echo; it also must not create the symbol on its own.
638	            result["bids"] = []
639	            result["asks"] = []
640	        else:
641	            # A pre-dispatch failure against a known symbol echoes the
642	            # untouched book, exactly like a baseline rejection does.
643	            result["bids"], result["asks"] = state.engine.snapshot()
644	        return result
645	
646	    def _submit_one(self, event: object) -> dict[str, object]:
647	        # ---- envelope validation (nothing is consumed on failure) --------
648	        if not isinstance(event, dict):
649	            return self._invalid(event)
650	        event_id = event.get("event_id")
651	        symbol = event.get("symbol")
652	        sequence = event.get("sequence")
653	        timestamp = event.get("timestamp")
654	        valid_envelope_ids = (
655	            isinstance(event_id, str)
656	            and event_id != ""
657	            and isinstance(symbol, str)
658	            and symbol != ""
659	            and isinstance(sequence, int)
660	            and not isinstance(sequence, bool)
661	            and sequence > 0
662	        )
663	        if not valid_envelope_ids:
664	            # The symbol cannot be trusted yet, so no book is echoed and no
665	            # symbol state is created.
666	            return self._invalid(event)
667	
668	        def reject_envelope(code: str = INVALID_EVENT) -> dict[str, object]:
669	            # A structurally invalid event for a recognizable symbol echoes the
670	            # untouched book but never mutates or registers anything.
671	            return self._invalid(event, code, state=self._symbols.get(symbol))
672	
673	        if "timestamp" in event and not _valid_timestamp(timestamp):
674	            return reject_envelope()
675	
676	        # The baseline payload is either nested under "event" or carried
677	        # inline alongside the envelope fields.
678	        if "event" in event:
679	            nested = event["event"]
680	            envelope_keys = _ENVELOPE_KEYS | {"event"}
681	            if not isinstance(nested, dict):
682	                return reject_envelope()
683	            payload: dict[str, object] = nested
684	            # The wrapper may only carry envelope fields plus the payload.
685	            if not set(event) <= envelope_keys:
686	                return reject_envelope()
687	        else:
688	            # The inline form may carry envelope fields plus exactly the fields
689	            # of its own payload kind.
690	            allowed_payload_keys = self._allowed_payload_keys(event.get("type"))
691	            if allowed_payload_keys is None or not set(event) <= (
692	                _ENVELOPE_KEYS | allowed_payload_keys
693	            ):
694	                return reject_envelope()
695	            # Keep event_id/type (payload fields); strip only symbol,
696	            # sequence and timestamp, which are envelope-only.
697	            payload = {
698	                key: value
699	                for key, value in event.items()
700	                if key not in ("symbol", "sequence", "timestamp")
701	            }
702	        event_type = payload.get("type")
703	        if not isinstance(event_type, str) or event_type not in SUPPORTED_TYPES:
704	            return reject_envelope()
705	        # Validate the full payload schema up front, so malformed content is
706	        # classified INVALID_EVENT and reaches neither ordering nor the book.
707	        # The wrapper and the payload must identify the same event.
708	        if payload.get("event_id") != event_id:
709	            return reject_envelope()
710	        if event_type in _TWAP_TYPES:
711	            schema_error = _twap_schema_error(payload)
712	        elif event_type in _VWAP_TYPES:
713	            schema_error = _vwap_schema_error(payload)
714	        else:
715	            schema_error = Engine._schema_error(payload)
716	        if schema_error is not None:
717	            return reject_envelope()
718	
719	        # A symbol state is created only once the event is fully well formed;
720	        # failures that precede dispatch must not register an empty book.
721	        state = self._symbols.get(symbol)
722	        known_symbol = state is not None
723	        if state is None:
724	            state = _SymbolState()
725	
726	        # ---- global idempotency (checked before sequencing) --------------
727	        # A retried delivery carries its original, now-stale sequence; it must
728	        # still be recognized as a duplicate rather than as out-of-order.
729	        content = canonical_json(payload).decode("utf-8")
730	        prior = self._events.get(event_id)
731	        if prior is not None:
732	            prior_symbol, prior_content = prior
733	            if prior_symbol == symbol and prior_content == content:
734	                bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()
735	                return {
736	                    "event_id": event_id,
737	                    "symbol": symbol,
738	                    "sequence": sequence,
739	                    "status": DUPLICATE,
740	                    "trades": [],
741	                    "book_changes": {"bids": [], "asks": []},
742	                    "bids": bids,
743	                    "asks": asks,
744	                }
745	            # Same id, different symbol or different normalized content: a
746	            # conflict consumes neither sequence nor book state, so the
747	            # correct next event can follow immediately.
748	            return self._invalid(
749	                event, EVENT_ID_CONFLICT,
750	                expected_sequence=state.last_sequence + 1 if known_symbol else None,
751	                state=state if known_symbol else None,
752	            )
753	
754	        # ---- per-symbol strict sequence ordering -------------------------
755	        expected = state.last_sequence + 1
756	        if sequence < expected or sequence > expected:
757	            code = OUT_OF_ORDER if sequence < expected else SEQUENCE_GAP
758	            return self._invalid(
759	                event, code, expected_sequence=expected,
760	                state=state if known_symbol else None,
761	            )
762	
763	        # ---- committed application ---------------------------------------
764	        # From here on the event is dispatched: register a brand new symbol
765	        # book and commit id/sequence exactly as the baseline does.
766	        if not known_symbol:
767	            self._symbols[symbol] = state
768	
769	        # A derived child id (``plan_id#slice``) is reserved from plan start;
770	        # it occupies both the order-id and event-id role of the future child,
771	        # so no external event — baseline or TWAP command — may reuse it as an
772	        # event id.
773	        if event_id in state.plan_index:
774	            # Committed like every baseline business rejection: the well-formed
775	            # event occupies its id and the sequence, but nothing else moves.
776	            state.last_sequence = sequence
777	            state.seen[event_id] = content
778	            self._events[event_id] = (symbol, content)
779	            bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()
780	            return {
781	                "event_id": event_id,
782	                "symbol": symbol,
783	                "sequence": sequence,
784	                "status": REJECTED,
785	                "rejection_code": DUPLICATE_EVENT_ID,
786	                "trades": [],
787	                "book_changes": {"bids": [], "asks": []},
788	                "bids": bids,
789	                "asks": asks,
790	            }
791	
792	        # ---- static per-security price limits -----------------------------
793	        # Enforced after the envelope, idempotency, sequence and identifier
794	        # conflict checks, and strictly before matching or any state change.
795	        # The identifier clashes the baseline engine would reach first (a
796	        # reused order id, a replace against a missing order, a duplicate plan
797	        # or a clashing derived id) keep their rejection-code precedence; a
798	        # price breach is only reported when none applies.
799	        price_rejection = self._price_limit_rejection(symbol, payload, event_type, state)
800	        if price_rejection is not None:
801	            # A committed business rejection: it occupies the event id and
802	            # advances the symbol sequence, but performs no matching, leaves
803	            # no order or plan behind and spends no trade id. Baseline event
804	            # ids also occupy the per-symbol engine journal, exactly as an
805	            # engine-side business rejection would; plan commands live solely
806	            # in the replay log.
807	            state.last_sequence = sequence
808	            state.seen[event_id] = content
809	            self._events[event_id] = (symbol, content)
810	            if event_type not in _PLAN_TYPES:
811	                state.engine.occupy_event_id(event_id)
812	            bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()
813	            return {
814	                "event_id": event_id,
815	                "symbol": symbol,
816	                "sequence": sequence,
817	                "status": REJECTED,
818	                "rejection_code": price_rejection,
819	                "trades": [],
820	                "book_changes": {"bids": [], "asks": []},
821	                "bids": bids,
822	                "asks": asks,
823	            }
824	
825	        if event_type in _PLAN_TYPES:
826	            out = self._dispatch_plan(
827	                event, payload, event_type, state, symbol, sequence, content
828	            )
829	            return out
830	
831	        before_bids, before_asks = state.engine.level_totals()
832	        before_bids = dict(before_bids)
833	        before_asks = dict(before_asks)
834	        _eid, engine_result, reason, trades, _stp, _analysis, _position = (
835	            state.engine.handle_object_position(payload)
836	        )
837	
838	        # Dispatched: the well-formed event occupies its id however the
839	        # business outcome ends, and the symbol's sequence advances exactly as
840	        # the input did. This mirrors the baseline's id-occupancy rule.
841	        state.last_sequence = sequence
842	        state.seen[event_id] = content
843	        self._events[event_id] = (symbol, content)
844	
845	        bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()
846	        book_changes = self._book_changes(state.engine, before_bids, before_asks)
847	        if reason is None:
848	            out: dict[str, object] = {
849	                "event_id": event_id,
850	                "symbol": symbol,
851	                "sequence": sequence,
852	                "status": ACCEPTED,
853	                "result": engine_result,
854	                "trades": trades,
855	                "book_changes": book_changes,
856	                "bids": bids,
857	                "asks": asks,
858	            }
859	        else:
860	            out = {
861	                "event_id": event_id,
862	                "symbol": symbol,
863	                "sequence": sequence,
864	                "status": REJECTED,
865	                # Baseline business rejection codes (UNKNOWN_ORDER,
866	                # DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID, ...) are preserved verbatim.
867	                "rejection_code": reason,
868	                "trades": trades,
869	                "book_changes": book_changes,
870	                "bids": bids,
871	                "asks": asks,
872	            }
873	        return out
874	
875	    def _price_limit_rejection(
876	        self,
877	        symbol: str,
878	        payload: dict[str, object],
879	        event_type: str,
880	        state: _SymbolState,
881	    ) -> str | None:
882	        """Decide a static price-limit breach without mutating anything.
883	
884	        Only the price of a LIMIT/ICEBERG ADD, of a REPLACE and of a LIMIT
885	        TWAP/VWAP plan is tested against the security's closed interval;
886	        MARKET orders and MARKET plans are exempt. Identifier clashes the
887	        baseline reaches first keep precedence and are reported as ``None``
888	        here: a reused order id, a replace against a non-resting target, a
889	        duplicate plan id or a clash over a derived child id.
890	        """
891	        bounds = self.price_limits.get(symbol)
892	        if bounds is None:
893	            return None
894	        lower, upper = bounds
895	
896	        def out_of_bounds(price: int) -> bool:
897	            return price < lower or price > upper
898	
899	        if event_type == ADD:
900	            order_type = payload["order_type"]
901	            if order_type not in (LIMIT, ICEBERG):
902	                return None
903	            order_id: str = payload["order_id"]
904	            if state.engine.has_order_id(order_id):
905	                # The engine would reject DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID first.
906	                return None
907	            return PRICE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED if out_of_bounds(payload["price"]) else None
908	
909	        if event_type == REPLACE:
910	            order_id = payload["order_id"]
911	            target_kind = state.engine.replace_target_kind(order_id)
912	            if target_kind is None:
913	                # A missing or finished target yields UNKNOWN_ORDER first.
914	                return None
915	            if target_kind == "plain" and "display_quantity" in payload:

917	                # must keep precedence and consume neither id nor sequence.

924	                return None
925	            plan_id: str = payload["plan_id"]
926	            if plan_id in state.plans:
927	                # Mirror _register_plan: the plan id clash wins.
928	                return None
929	            if event_type == TWAP_START:
930	                child_count: int = payload["slice_count"]
931	            else:
932	                child_count = len(payload["volume_weights"])

958	    def _dispatch_plan(
959	        self,
960	        event: dict[str, object],
961	        payload: dict[str, object],
962	        event_type: str,
963	        state: _SymbolState,
964	        symbol: str,
965	        sequence: int,
966	        content: str,
967	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
968	        """Dispatch a structurally valid, in-sequence parent-order command.
969	
970	        Every branch commits the well-formed event id and advances the symbol
971	        sequence, including business rejections: this matches the baseline
972	        rule that a valid event occupies its id whatever the business result.
973	        """
974	        event_id: str = event["event_id"]
975	
976	        before_bids, before_asks = state.engine.level_totals()
977	        before_bids = dict(before_bids)
978	        before_asks = dict(before_asks)
979	
980	        if event_type == TWAP_START:
981	            result_out = self._twap_start(payload, state)
982	        elif event_type == VWAP_START:
983	            result_out = self._vwap_start(payload, state)
984	        elif event_type in (TWAP_SLICE, VWAP_SLICE):
985	            result_out = self._plan_slice(payload, state)
986	        elif event_type in (TWAP_CANCEL, VWAP_CANCEL):
987	            result_out = self._plan_cancel(payload, state)
988	        else:
989	            result_out = self._plan_report(payload, state)
990	
991	        # The structurally valid command occupies its event id and the symbol
992	        # sequence whatever its business outcome.
993	        state.last_sequence = sequence
994	        state.seen[event_id] = content
995	        self._events[event_id] = (symbol, content)
996	
997	        # Only a released slice can move the book; compute the change set with
998	        # the same level-diff routine the baseline path uses, so drained
999	        # levels and iceberg replenishment are reported identically.
1000	        book_changes = self._book_changes(state.engine, before_bids, before_asks)
1001	        return self._plan_response(
1002	            event_id, symbol, sequence, state, result_out, book_changes
1003	        )

1040	    @staticmethod
1041	    def _register_plan(
1042	        state: _SymbolState, plan: ExecutionPlan
1043	    ) -> tuple[str, str | None, ExecutionPlan | None, None]:
1044	        """Register a new plan and reserve its derived ids.
1045	
1046	        TWAP and VWAP plans share the per-symbol ``plan_id`` namespace, so a
1047	        duplicate id rejects whatever algorithm started the existing plan.
1048	        Every derived id is reserved up front; a clash with an existing order
1049	        or another plan's derived id rejects the start before anything is
1050	        registered, so the event leaves no plan or reservation behind.
1051	        """
1052	        plan_id = plan.plan_id
1053	        if plan_id in state.plans:
1054	            return REJECTED, DUPLICATE_EXECUTION_PLAN, None, None
1055	        for child_id in plan.child_ids():
1056	            if state.engine.has_order_id(child_id) or child_id in state.plan_index:
1057	                return REJECTED, DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID, None, None
1058	        for child_id in plan.child_ids():
1059	            state.engine.reserve_order_id(child_id)
1060	            state.plan_index[child_id] = plan_id
1061	        state.plans[plan_id] = plan
1062	        return ACCEPTED, None, plan, None
1063	
1064	    def _plan_slice(
1065	        self, payload: dict[str, object], state: _SymbolState
1066	    ) -> tuple[str, str | None, ExecutionPlan | None, dict[str, object] | None]:
1067	        """Release the next slice as an IOC child order against current book."""
1068	        plan_id: str = payload["plan_id"]
1069	        plan = state.plans.get(plan_id)
1070	        if plan is None:
1071	            return REJECTED, UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_PLAN, None, None
1072	        if plan.status != PLAN_ACTIVE:
1073	            return REJECTED, EXECUTION_PLAN_CLOSED, None, None
1074	
1075	        slice_number = plan.released + 1
1076	        child_id = plan.child_order_id(slice_number)
1077	        quantity = plan.slice_quantities[plan.released]
1078	
1079	        child: dict[str, object] = {
1080	            "event_id": child_id,
1081	            "type": ADD,
1082	            "order_id": child_id,
1083	            "side": plan.side,
1084	            "order_type": plan.order_type,
1085	            "quantity": quantity,
1086	            "time_in_force": IOC,
1087	        }
1088	        if plan.order_type == LIMIT:
1089	            child["price"] = plan.price
1090	        if plan.account_id is not None:
1091	            child["account_id"] = plan.account_id
1092	
1093	        # The child id was reserved at plan start; release it immediately
1094	        # before the baseline ADD spends it through the regular path.
1095	        state.engine.release_order_id(child_id)
1096	        _eid, engine_result, reason, trades, _stp = state.engine.handle_object(child)
1097	        # A correctly synthesized child can only fail on a programming error;
1098	        # fail loudly rather than corrupt the plan counters.
1099	        if reason is not None:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
1100	            raise RuntimeError(f"plan slice child order rejected: {reason}")
1101	
1102	        traded_quantity = sum(trade["quantity"] for trade in trades)
1103	        plan.released += 1
1104	        plan.released_quantity += quantity
1105	        plan.filled_quantity += traded_quantity
1106	        plan.notional += sum(trade["price"] * trade["quantity"] for trade in trades)
1107	        if plan.released == plan.slice_count:
1108	            plan.status = PLAN_COMPLETED
1109	
1110	        slice_info = {
1111	            "slice_number": slice_number,
1112	            "child_order_id": child_id,
1113	            "engine_result": engine_result,
1114	            "trades": trades,
1115	        }
1116	        if plan.algorithm == ALGORITHM_VWAP:
1117	            # A successful VWAP slice also reports its scheduled bucket.
1118	            slice_info["target_weight"] = plan.volume_weights[slice_number - 1]
1119	            slice_info["scheduled_quantity"] = quantity
1120	        return ACCEPTED, None, plan, slice_info
1121	
1122	    def _plan_cancel(
1123	        self, payload: dict[str, object], state: _SymbolState
1124	    ) -> tuple[str, str | None, ExecutionPlan | None, None]:
1125	        """Count the unreleased quantity as cancelled and close the plan.
1126	
1127	        Purely a plan-state change: no resting order is touched, no trade id
1128	        or historical trade changes.
1129	        """
1130	        plan_id: str = payload["plan_id"]
1131	        plan = state.plans.get(plan_id)
1132	        if plan is None:
1133	            return REJECTED, UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_PLAN, None, None
1134	        if plan.status != PLAN_ACTIVE:
1135	            return REJECTED, EXECUTION_PLAN_CLOSED, None, None
1136	
1137	        unreleased = plan.total_quantity - plan.released_quantity
1138	        plan.cancelled_quantity += unreleased
1139	        plan.status = PLAN_CANCELLED
1140	        return ACCEPTED, None, plan, None

1142	    def _plan_report(
1143	        self, payload: dict[str, object], state: _SymbolState
1144	    ) -> tuple[str, str | None, ExecutionPlan | None, None]:
1145	        """Read-only cumulative plan summary; closed plans stay queryable."""
1146	        plan_id: str = payload["plan_id"]
1147	        plan = state.plans.get(plan_id)
1148	        if plan is None:
1149	            return REJECTED, UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_PLAN, None, None
1150	        return ACCEPTED, None, plan, None

1152	    @staticmethod
1153	    def _plan_response(
1154	        event_id: str,
1155	        symbol: str,
1156	        sequence: int,
1157	        state: _SymbolState,
1158	        result_out: tuple[str, str | None, ExecutionPlan | None, dict[str, object] | None],
1159	        book_changes: dict[str, list[dict[str, int]]],
1160	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
1161	        """Assemble the plan command result, including book and plan summary."""
1162	        status, code, plan, slice_info = result_out
1163	        bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()
1164	        if status == ACCEPTED:
1165	            if slice_info is None:
1166	                # START, CANCEL and REPORT never move the book.
1167	                trades: list[dict[str, object]] = []
1168	                result: str | None = None
1169	                slice_number = child_order_id = None
1170	                target_weight = scheduled_quantity = None
1171	            else:
1172	                trades = slice_info["trades"]
1173	                result = slice_info["engine_result"]
1174	                slice_number = slice_info["slice_number"]
1175	                child_order_id = slice_info["child_order_id"]
1176	                target_weight = slice_info.get("target_weight")
1177	                scheduled_quantity = slice_info.get("scheduled_quantity")
1178	            out: dict[str, object] = {
1179	                "event_id": event_id,
1180	                "symbol": symbol,
1181	                "sequence": sequence,
1182	                "status": ACCEPTED,
1183	                "trades": trades,
1184	                "book_changes": book_changes,
1185	                "bids": bids,
1186	                "asks": asks,
1187	            }
1188	            if result is not None:
1189	                out["result"] = result
1190	            out["execution_plan"] = plan.summary(
1191	                slice_number=slice_number,
1192	                child_order_id=child_order_id,
1193	                target_weight=target_weight,
1194	                scheduled_quantity=scheduled_quantity,
1195	            ) if plan is not None else None
1196	            return out
1197	        # Business rejection: the book is untouched by the command itself.
1198	        return {
1199	            "event_id": event_id,
1200	            "symbol": symbol,
1201	            "sequence": sequence,
1202	            "status": REJECTED,
1203	            "rejection_code": code,
1204	            "trades": [],
1205	            "book_changes": {"bids": [], "asks": []},
1206	            "bids": bids,
1207	            "asks": asks,
1208	        }
